detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for packages with suspicious or typosquatted names, especially those that appear suddenly and mimic popular or internal packages. Use automated malware detection systems to flag packages with unusual behaviors or lacking legitimate documentation. Review flagged packages for signs of dependency confusion or other supply chain attacks.
